summary.text: David Boyd is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 90 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Andrew Ireland (R).
Boyd served in the U.S. Navy and has worked as an insurance adjuster and a transportation security officer.

paragraphs.text: David Boyd earned a high school diploma from Ellison High School and served in the U.S. Navy, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an insurance adjuster and transportation security officer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Boyd said he is running because residents of Franklin and Perry Townships face an affordability crisis and he believes the incumbent is not adequately advocating for constituents at the Statehouse.
He listed three key messages: improving roads and infrastructure, strong public schools, and support for Hoosier families.
Under the school-funding message, he said he supports raising teacher salaries, increasing state funding for public schools, and mandating student-teacher ratios.
Under the family message, he said he supports increasing access to Medicaid, regulating utility rates, and subsidizing housing assistance programs.
